written: Over the course of each day, listen to the world's radio, about fifteen moments every hour, 365 in all. Keep what has something in it, or, one day in seven, keep everything. In the evening, throw the dice to choose which sounds belong together and which patterns of data to fuse them with, and as the days pass, do a little less to what you hear. Make between five and thirteen songs. Title them with words cut from what was heard. Draw the album as a record, one groove spiralling in. Release it at midnight. Delete it the next day. Each day, stop forever by chance: 1 in 365, then 1 in 364 the next day, one fewer each day, until the day it is certain.
